messages:
morgan: Heads-up — found a broken anchor in the runtime guide under the KV cache section. landing page link 404s when you click the `Caching -> KV cache` anchor. Can the owner of runtime-guide take a quick look?

alex: thanks for flagging. can you paste the exact link?

morgan: sure — https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime#kv-cache (the anchor jump fails, page scrolls to top)

sasha: i ran the link-scan yesterday and flagged a handful, this one slipped by. looks like the header id changed in the last mdx refactor.

priya: if it's just an anchor rename i can open a tiny PR to re-add the anchor id and update the TOC. give me 15.

morgan: perfect — if you do that, can you also update the internal curl snippet that references the anchor? it's in the same file.

priya: will do. quick plan: 1) add `id="kv-cache"` back to the header 2) update the curl snippet link 3) run local doc build to sanity check.

docs-bot: :robot_face: docs link-scan detected 1 new broken anchor in /guides/runtime.md — created issue #4823 (triage)

alex: pinging owners list for runtime-guide: @nate (primary), @sasha (secondary) — nate, is it okay if priya opens the PR?

nate: totally fine, thanks for the heads-up. please include a quick changelog blurb and add me as reviewer. if you want I can approve once CI passes.

priya: PR created — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234 — tiny MD fix + updated curl snippet. ran `yarn dev` locally, anchor jump fixed. cc @nate for review. :sparkles:

alex: nice, thanks. left a small nit about the snippet wording, but nothing blocking.

nate: reviewing now. if all good i'll merge and trigger the site deploy.

morgan: amazing — appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:

priya: merged and deployed, netlify preview looked good. closing thread.
